legacyFrozen.note: L0 preserves the original pnpm lockfile; no routine dependency upgrade

freezeRules: T06 must run compatibility checks before accepting these candidates; registry latest alone is not approval.
Expo controls its compatible React and React Native versions via expo install; do not force desktop React into mobile.
Recheck each selected dependency's license before first installation; T06 cannot freeze a dependency until its license and compatibility are recorded.
Pin exact npm versions and commit pnpm-lock.yaml; commit Cargo.lock and rust-toolchain.toml.
If a candidate is incompatible, record the smallest stable adjustment in ADR-versions and rerun the same gates.
Recheck repository activity, release, license and runtime support before first installation if implementation starts later.
